The behavior technician implemented antecedent strategies during the session. The behavior technician utilized a first-then board prior to each demand. The behavior technician provided a one-minute warning prior to each transition. The client demonstrated the ability to tolerate three of four transitions. The behavior technician utilized offered choices to increase motivation. The client engaged in elopement on two occasions during the session. The behavior technician utilized redirection contingent on elopement. The behavior technician determined that the strategies were moderately effective.
